blocks.heading: The build is scaling — and the finance function can't keep pace.
blocks.lead: Data center builds involve intricate debt stacks, construction loans, and strict financial covenants. Without rigorous internal controls and audit-ready reporting, a single missed metric or mismanaged draw schedule can trigger a default or stall a multi-million-dollar build.

cards.title: Draw schedules outpace your forecast
cards.body: Funding construction milestones, vendor invoices, and contractor pay applications keeps colliding with delayed financing tranches — and you're managing liquidity reactively instead of modeling it ahead.

cards.title: The capital stack demands real modeling
cards.body: Lenders and investors ask about DSCR, capital-stack optimization, and phase-level IRR — and your team can't produce institutional-grade models and stress tests on demand.

cards.title: Job-level margins stay murky
cards.body: Project volume is high, but true profitability isn't clear until a build closes out. Cost overruns and unrecovered change orders surface too late to fix, with no real-time committed-vs-actual tracking.

blocks.heading: Data center capital demands absolute precision.
blocks.body: Power Capital provides executive financial architecture for data centers, construction, and real estate—protecting high-stakes builds from draw friction and compliance gridlock.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: Reach out through the contact form or on LinkedIn, and tell us where the business is and where you want it to go.

steps.title: Financial health review
steps.body: A look at your books, cash position, and reporting to surface quick wins and real risks.

steps.title: CFO roadmap
steps.body: We present the priorities for the next 90 days and the engagement that fits.

steps.title: Ongoing rhythm
steps.body: Forecasts, reporting, and review meetings on a cadence that fits your business, so you always know where you stand.

blocks.heading: Your Next Move
blocks.body: Send us a message or connect on LinkedIn to tell us about your business and what you're looking for. No pressure, no obligation.
